title: Program Distillation: Transferring LLM Capability from System 2 to System 0
abstract: arXiv:2611.19461v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent studies leverage large language models (LLMs) to construct executable programs through environment interaction, feedback analysis, and code revision. However, prior work has mainly treated LLMs as optimizers, overlooking their ability to transfer knowledge across system levels. We propose Program Distillation (PD), a framework that formalizes the transfer of abilities from System 2 to System 0. During learning, the LLM provides task knowledge and draft strategies; at deployment, a student program executes the resulting policy. We show that this approach can improve performance while reducing inference time. We introduce PDBench, a benchmark comprising 27 discrete- and continuous-control tasks with fixed initial policies, and PDMetaHarness, a model-harness-independent meta-system for monitoring and guiding the learning process. The strongest model achieves a normalized mean score of 0.728, surpassing PPO (0.656) and Jev-like decisi

translated_title: 程序蒸馏：将大语言模型能力从系统2迁移至系统0
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.19461v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：近期研究利用大语言模型（LLM）通过环境交互、反馈分析和代码修改来构建可执行程序。然而，先前的工作主要将LLM视为优化器，忽视了其在不同系统层级之间迁移知识的能力。我们提出了程序蒸馏，这是一个将能力从系统2到系统0的迁移过程形式化的框架。在学习阶段，LLM提供任务知识和初始策略草稿；在部署阶段，由学生程序执行所得策略。我们证明该方法能够在降低推理时间的同时提升性能。我们引入了PDBench，一个包含27个具有固定初始策略的离散与连续控制任务的基准测试，以及PDMetaHarness，一个独立于模型和执行框架的元系统，用于监控和引导学习过程。最强的模型达到了0.728的归一化平均得分，超过了PPO（0.656）和类似Jev的决策方法（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出“程序蒸馏”框架，将LLM在系统2层面的推理与规划能力蒸馏为系统0层面可直接执行的学生程序策略，在大幅降低推理时间的同时取得优于PPO等方法的性能，并配套提出PDBench基准和PDMetaHarness元系统来支撑学习过程的评估与引导。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Program Distillation (PD), a framework that distills the LLM's System 2 reasoning capability into an executable System 0 student-program policy, achieving better performance than PPO with significantly reduced inference time, supported by the PDBench benchmark and the model-harness-independent PDMetaHarness meta-system.
